criteria.description: Returns all six requested JSON fields and the exact threshold label.
criteria.name: final_json_and_label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for an equivalent label with one numeric omission, or 1 point for a mostly correct label with an incomplete JSON object.

criteria.description: Extracts 119 mm, 250 mm, the 140-200 mm annual range, and the 170 mm midpoint.
criteria.name: report_rainfall_anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for three correct anchors, or 1 point for only one or two correct anchors.

criteria.description: Computes 17.9 mm, 37.5 mm, 0.70, and 1.47 using the stated coefficient and annual midpoint.
criteria.name: runoff_and_annual_share_arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct formulas with minor rounding errors, or 1 point for applying the coefficient to only one rainfall anchor.

criteria.description: Identifies 56.76 mm as the highest gridded event maximum and computes 0.568 against the 100 mm threshold.
criteria.name: gridded_maximum_ratio
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the right source value with wrong rounding, or 1 point for comparing a lower gridded value to the threshold.

criteria.description: Explains that both report rainfall anchors exceed the 100 mm / 15 mm runoff-equivalent threshold while the gridded maximum remains below 100 mm.
criteria.name: threshold_logic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points if one side of the threshold logic is correct, or 1 point if the comparison direction is right but values are missing.

criteria.description: Provides a concise interpretation tied to the computed diagnostic without adding extra loss or depth claims.
criteria.name: computed_interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a reasonable but wordy interpretation or for omitting one important numeric link.
